message.content:
Read-only investigation in /opt/nxeon (Next.js App Router + Prisma + systemd worker + Proxmox + Mailcow hosting platform). Do NOT edit any file. I am writing internal documentation and need VERIFIED facts with real `file:line` citations (absolute paths, e.g. /opt/nxeon/lib/mailcow.ts:120). Be very thorough. Flag anything simulated, stubbed, or written-but-never-read — this codebase has a known overclaiming problem.

Investigate the DOMAINS / SSL / MAIL cluster:

1. Domains: `lib/actions-domains.ts`, `lib/actions-domains-dns.ts`, `lib/actions-domains-advanced.ts`, `lib/registrar.ts`, `app/api/domains/**`, `app/dashboard/domains/**`. Search/availability, registration, the registrar backend (is Namecheap real or stubbed? which env vars gate it?), DNS record CRUD, nameservers, where DNS actually lives (Cloudflare? local bind? PowerDNS?). Describe the customer screens well enough for an ASCII wireframe.
2. Transfer-in: `lib/actions-domains-transfer.ts`, `lib/domain-transfer.ts`, `app/dashboard/domains/transfer` — the full state machine (statuses), EPP code handling, polling, emails.
3. Cloudflare OAuth: `lib/cloudflare-oauth.ts`, `lib/cloudflare-connect-intent.ts`, `lib/cloudflare-intent-run.ts`, `lib/cloudflare-dns.ts`, `lib/cloudflare-point.ts`, `app/api/integrations/cloudflare/**`, `lib/actions-cloudflare.ts`. The exact OAuth flow (endpoints, state, token storage/encryption), the "intent" concept, what DNS it writes automatically.
4. SSL lifecycle: `worker/ssl.ts` (1061 lines), `lib/actions-ssl.ts`, `app/dashboard/ssl`. Issuance (certbot? acme.sh? HTTP-01 vs DNS-01), renewal, where certs live, wildcard handling, failure modes, and how an admin issues a cert BY HAND (find the real command).
5. Nxeon Mail (the webmail client): `lib/actions-mail.ts`, `lib/actions-mailbox-settings.ts`, `app/dashboard/mail`, `app/api/mail/**`, `lib/actions-calendar.ts`, `app/dashboard/calendar`. What protocol it speaks (IMAP/SMTP libs?), attachments, signatures, folders.
6. Business email hosting + DKIM: `lib/actions-email-hosting.ts` (35KB), `lib/mailcow.ts`, `lib/actions-mail-admin.ts`, `app/dashboard/email`, `app/admin/mail`, `app/admin/email-plans`. Mailbox provisioning against the Mailcow API, domain add, DKIM key generation and where the DKIM record is shown/published, plans/quotas.
7. Transactional mail: `lib/mailer.ts` (22KB), `lib/email-templates.ts`, `lib/email-render.ts`, `app/admin/email-templates`. How mail is sent (SMTP to mailcow? which host/port/auth), the template catalog, retries.
8. Mail deliverability diagnostics: `scripts/diag-email.ts`, `scripts/set-mail-ptr.ts`, `scripts/test-mail-imap.ts`, `scripts/mail-nat.sh`. IMPORTANT: I need to document a trap where `/etc/hosts` + `nsswitch: files myhostname dns` makes the SYSTEM RESOLVER answer reverse lookups from a local file, so deliverability checks must query AUTHORITATIVE nameservers instead. Find where in the code/scripts this is handled or not handled, and check the actual `/etc/nsswitch.conf` and `/etc/hosts` on this machine (read-only) to confirm the trap is real. Report exactly what you find.
9. `lib/dedicated-ip.ts` — how a dedicated IP / rDNS(PTR) is set.

Report every citation as /opt/nxeon/path:line.
